''Jadran'' (1923) and ''Radnički'' (1934) | ground = [[Stadion Luke (Visoko)|Stadion Luke]], [[Visoko]] | capacity = 5,200 | chairman = Nihad Smailagić | manager = Eldin Dedić | league = [[Second League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Second League of FBiH]] (Center) | season = 2024–25 | position = Second League of FBiH (Center), 5th of 16 | pattern_la1= | pattern_b1= | pattern_ra1= | leftarm1=FFF000 | body1=FFF000 | rightarm1=FFF000 | shorts1=0000FF | socks1=FFF000 | pattern_la2= | pattern_b2= | pattern_ra2= | leftarm2=A100AB | body2=A100AB | rightarm2=A100AB | shorts2=FFF000 | socks2=A100AB }} '''Nogometni klub Bosna Visoko''' ({{langx|en|Bosna Football Club}}) is a professional [[association football]] club from the city of [[Visoko]] that is situated in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. Currently, Bosna plays in the [[Second League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] (Group Center) and plays its home matches on [[Stadion Luke (Visoko)|Stadion Luke]] which has a capacity of 5,200 seats. The club's greatest success was in the late 1990s. Guided by manager [[Ivo Ištuk]], Bosna won the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Cup|Bosnian Cup]], [[Supercup of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnian Supercup]] and came close to winning the league title in the [[1997–98 First League of Bosnia and Herzegovina|1997–98 season]]."}}
